# PilotStack

> PilotStack is an independent software research site that helps B2B buyers choose the right tools. We publish hands-on product reviews, head-to-head comparisons, best-software guides, buying guides, market research reports, and verified pricing and usage statistics across 12 categories including CRM, project management, analytics, developer tools, HR, marketing, finance, and security.

PilotStack does not accept payment for reviews or placements. Every review follows a published methodology: a minimum of two weeks of hands-on testing, scored against a five-dimension rubric, and cross-checked against public user feedback from G2, Capterra, and TrustRadius. Revenue comes from clearly disclosed affiliate commissions.

## Site information

- [Homepage](https://pilotstack.online/): Latest guides, comparisons, and reviews
